summary.text: Sam Singh is a Democratic member of the Michigan Senate and serves as Majority Floor Leader, according to his caucus biography.
He is the first Indian American elected to the Michigan Senate and previously served three terms in the state House.

paragraphs.text: Singh was elected to the East Lansing City Council in 1995 at age 24 and served three terms, one as mayor.
He has also been president and CEO of the Michigan Nonprofit Association, senior consultant for the New Economy Initiative, and CEO of Public Policy Associates.
He served in the state House from 2013 to 2018, and in his last term his colleagues chose him as Democratic Leader.
He is a graduate of Michigan State University and lives in East Lansing with his wife, Kerry, and their son, Remy.
